"""Case facts and student-facing decisions for Dock to Dollar."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AccountEvent:
    id: str
    date: str
    label: str
    changes: tuple[tuple[str, int], ...]
    unit_change: int = 0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Decision:
    id: str
    phase: int
    document: str
    title: str
    story: str
    prompt: str
    options: tuple[str, ...]
    correct: str
    explanation: str
    hint: str
    statement_effect: str
    event_id: str | None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StatementQuestion:
    id: str
    prompt: str
    options: tuple[str, ...]
    correct: str
    explanation: str
    hint: str
